style: Flat cartoon character illustration in a bright, cheerful, child-friendly picture-book style for Malaysian primary school children aged 9, matching simple flat vector art: soft rounded shapes, clean dark outlines, flat colours with very light shading. The character is a cute chibi rhinoceros hornbill (burung enggang) from Malaysia: a round, chubby black body with a white belly patch, a large friendly face with big round shiny dark eyes and small eyebrows, a very large, long, down-curved banana-shaped yellow beak (about as long as its head is wide) with a bright orange-red casque sitting directly ON TOP OF THE BEAK and curving upward at the front tip like a rhinoceros horn (the casque is part of the beak, not on the head; there is no crest or tuft of feathers on top of the head), a short white tail with a black band, short orange feet, and two small black wings it uses like hands. It always looks warm, kind and encouraging. Full body, centred, filling about 80% of the square, on a plain solid pure white background (#FFFFFF) with no shadow, no ground, no scenery and no other objects unless the pose names one. Square 1:1. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words or signs anywhere in the image.
consistency: Keep EXACTLY the same character as in the attached reference picture: same body shape and proportions, same colours, same beak and casque, same eyes, same line style. Only the pose and facial expression change.
